title: IPv6: Implementation of conversations with stream identifiers
description:
IPv6 implementation of conversations in addition of the existing
conversation table. This uses stream IDs, similarly to some other
protocols already working this way.

changes_data.diff:
@@ -75,6 +75,7 @@ typedef struct _ws_ip6
     guint8  ip6_hop;     /* hop limit */
     address ip6_src;     /* source address */
     address ip6_dst;     /* destination address */
+    guint32 ip6_stream;  /* track conversations */
 } ws_ip6;
 
 #define WS_IP6_PTR(p)         ((ws_ip6 *)(((p) && *(guint8 *)(p) == 6) ? (p) : NULL))

@@ -849,6 +849,7 @@ bool ConversationDataModel::showConversationId(int row) const
     if (conv_item && (conv_item->ctype == CONVERSATION_TCP ||
                       conv_item->ctype == CONVERSATION_UDP ||
                       conv_item->ctype == CONVERSATION_IP  ||
+                      conv_item->ctype == CONVERSATION_IPV6||
                       conv_item->ctype == CONVERSATION_ETH))
         return true;
     return false;
